summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Reversal & UTR Operator Console over existing backend APIs. All 6 acceptance criteria verified end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend was NOT tested (as instructed).

tests_executed.reversal_authorized_super_admin: PASS — Logged in as finance@vortexglobal.info, switched tenant to Acme Commerce via tenant-selector -> tenant-option-acme. Eligible for reversal table listed 8 payments (statuses succeeded). Clicked reverse-button-<id>, confirm dialog (reverse-confirm-dialog) opened with reverse-reason-input; entered reason and clicked reverse-confirm. Toast 'Reversal succeeded — $96.80 unwound' displayed, list refreshed, reversed payment appeared in reversals-history (reversal-done-row-<id>). POST /api/payments/{id}/reverse worked.
tests_executed.reversal_unauthorized_ops_admin: PASS — Logged in as ops-admin@cloudpay.io: nav-reversals hidden from sidebar. Direct navigation to /dashboard/reversals rendered reversals-no-permission panel with correct copy. No reverse-button elements present.
tests_executed.utr_list_and_review_authorized: PASS — GET /api/payments/utr/list loaded pending rows (utr-pending-row-<id>). Approve (utr-approve-<id>) opened utr-review-dialog with prefilled utr-expected-amount and utr-expected-currency. utr-review-confirm produced 'UTR confirmed' toast; row moved to Resolved. Reject flow (utr-reject-<id>) also opened the dialog and rejected successfully with 'UTR rejected' toast + Resolved section shows reason 'test reject'.
tests_executed.utr_submission: PASS — utr-open-submit opens utr-submit-dialog. Filled utr-submit-ref (unique ACMETEST...), utr-submit-amount (250000), utr-submit-currency defaulted USD, submitted via utr-submit-confirm. Success toast 'UTR submitted for review' shown, list refreshed, new row visible in Pending review. POST /api/payments/utr sent correct tenant_id param.
tests_executed.utr_unauthorized_ops_admin: PASS — nav-utr hidden from sidebar for ops-admin. Direct navigation to /dashboard/utr rendered utr-no-permission panel.
tests_executed.tenant_isolation: PASS — With 7 tenants in selector, switching between Acme Commerce and FinTest 676fda76 produced distinctly different eligible/UTR lists (Acme had 8 eligible payments + 3+ reversed; FinTest showed different UTR data). Console consistently sends tenant_id of the selected tenant.

critical_code_review_comments: Reversals.jsx: UI-side REVERSIBLE filter mirrors server; documented as UX-only — good, backend re-validates. No issue.

UtrConsole.jsx: submitUtr sends tenant_id as query param (?tenant_id=...) while other endpoints on this page send it in params — consistent. If a payment_id is provided but blank-stripped correctly. Good.

Minor UX: In UtrConsole submit dialog, form.currency defaults to 'USD' hardcoded. For non-USD tenants this may require the user to change every time. Consider defaulting to tenant.default_currency. (Non-blocking.)
Minor UX: reverse-confirm-dialog does not auto-clear when target changes rapidly; not an issue in practice.
Both pages correctly reload data via `load()` after mutations and gate on hasPermission. selectedTenantId is guarded before API calls (returns early).

context_for_next_testing_agent: New pages Reversals.jsx and UtrConsole.jsx are wired to existing backend endpoints and behave correctly. Tenant selector on /dashboard/* topbar exposes data-testid tenant-selector and tenant-option-<slug>. Note: on /superadmin route the tenant selector is NOT rendered — sidebar/nav is different; testing must navigate to /dashboard/reversals or /dashboard/utr first to reach the standard Layout that contains the tenant selector.
